title: Vega, Lalla, Nick LaRocca and the Christian brothers
summary: He doesn't know Lawrence Vega as a musician or Lalla or LaRocca; he knew the Christian brothers.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I wonder do you uh remember Lawrence Vega a trumpet or carnet player? Vega? Vega.

Well I knew a Lawrence Vega but uh Vega. Vega. He was no uh he was no musician. He was uh he used to uh take work contract work because I think I'd done some work for him Brickwood. Lawrence Vega. Vega. Vega. Vega. Vega. Vega.
No it must be a different man. I think this man played with Papa Lane with Jack Lane. Ah. Did you know uh Johnny Lalla played carnet? Do you remember Johnny Lalla? I think he was from downtown.
No I don't remember him either.

Do you remember um uh Nick LaRocca the original Dixieland band? Eddie Edwards and uh Emil Christian played with him for a while too different fellas. Nunez played with him for a while. Yellow Nunez played with Nick LaRocca. Do you remember hearing Nick LaRocca when you were playing? No. No. He was from uptown to the Irish Channel. Of course the Christian brothers were down here. Yeah the Christian brothers were down this way.
Yeah I knew them well. I knew them well. There was Johnny Christian and another one. Well I wasn't so much acquainted with the names but I know one was Johnny Christian.
Emil Christian is still living. Frank Christian was a carnet player too. Yeah. Emil still plays trombone and bass. Mm-hmm.
Well those fellas are much younger men than I am I know.
